projects.name: 2.1.4 UNOPS - EU Support to Local Development Programme - EU PRO Plus
projects.description:
U PRO PLUS focuses its work on enhancing territorial development management, supporting economic growth, and improving social infrastructure and cohesion. 
Within efforts to Improve development planning and introduce integrated territorial investment concept, the Programme supports development of Sustainable Urban Development (SUD) and Integrated Territorial Investment (ITI) strategies using EU territorial mechanisms. The key beneficiaries are local self-governments and regional development agencies, along with institutions at institutions at local and regional levels. The Programme also supports design of the national model for integrated and sustainable territorial development at the national level, in partnership with the Ministry of European Integrations. 

In 2023, development of 12 territorial strategies is planned to be completed, and a grant scheme for implementation of projects deriving from these strategies launched. Additionally, EU PRO Plus will implement a number of capacity building activities for stakeholders at all levels. 

Equal opportunities and representation of women in activities related to capacity building are supported by inclusion elements of gender equality in the Plan for building the capacity of national institutions for the introduction of instruments of integral territorial development.

The EU Support to Integrated Sustainable Territorial Development – EU INTEGRA is a flagship initiative funded by the European Union (EU) to advance integrated territorial development in Serbia. The Programme supports the implementation of the EU Cohesion Policy 2021–2027 by enhancing governance, reducing regional disparities, and preparing Serbian institutions for future structural and investment funding. With a total budget of 15 million Euros, the Programme is implemented under the strategic leadership of the Ministry of European Integration (MEI), and delivered through two complementary components: The Standing Conference of Towns and Municipalities (SCTM) is responsible for implementing a project worth 12 million Euros, which includes managing a 10.14 million Euro grant scheme aimed at supporting integrated development projects and strengthening local capacities for territorial governance.
UNOPS manages 3 million Euros to strengthen the institutional framework, build capacities, and support the development and implementation of territorial strategies at the national, regional, and local levels. EU INTEGRA builds on the experiences of previous EU-funded Programmes, including the EU PRO Plus, scaling up Serbia’s readiness for future EU Cohesion Policy funding and reinforcing territorial development efforts.

The overarching goal of the project is to enhance national authorities' capacities to achieve effective and efficient migration governance and protection of rights of individuals in need of international protection, as well as other vulnerable individuals within mixed movements in Serbia.
